learning_outcomes:
CHESB_Learning outcomes 1. Major Programme:
Knowledge
outcomes:
•  |  A
broad-based and integrated comprehension of the complexities of Chinese
history, culture, languages and contemporary society, including the
integrated realms of the economy, governance, and business.
•  |  A
high-level of knowledge acquired through the direct social and practical
engagement with Chinese society through social-cultural “immersion” and
“on-the-ground” experiential and social enterprise learning.
•  |  A
focused area of specific topical knowledge about China explored through
intensive empirical research (mainly the capstone research sequence in the
final year).
•  |  An
understanding and appreciation of the existing and developing multiple needs
and opportunities
for the shared productive action of Chinese citizens and members of the
international community together with respect to global challenges.
Skills
outcomes:
•  |  A
high level of proficiency in Chinese language (Putonghua), including in
reading and writing Chinese, at the level needed to be China-specialist
analysts, effective cross-cultural communicators and social network builders
linking China with the world.
•  |  A
high level of spoken and written English language ability to support
effective communication in cross-cultural discussions about China in
international arenas.
•  |  A
high level ability in critical thinking, rational analysis, logical
persuasive argumentation, and original empirical research necessary for
today’s China specialist analysts.
•  |  A
notable skill level at effective cross-cultural problem solving, negotiation,
and joint enterprise development gained through the social-cultural
“immersion” experience and “on-the-ground” in China experiential and social
enterprise learning.
Values
and attitude outcomes:
•  |  A
high level of cross-cultural respect, tolerance, appreciation and compassion,
along with an attentiveness to reflection on essential social-ethical values,
drawn from interactive student discussions, social-cultural immersion,
experiential and social enterprise learning in China.
